candidate.rationale: Top recent candidates struggled with primaryPromote despite shadow ROI gains from tuned exit logic. The current champion uses a slower divRsiLen of 21 and a minPredSum of 1.8. By shortening the divergence baseline to 14, we generate more responsive divergence context, while simultaneously raising minPredSum to 2.0 to filter out lower-confidence entries caused by the increased signal frequency. A riskRewardRatio of 2.5 is introduced to secure more consistent lock-ins.
